campaigns.title: Save Little Aarav
campaigns.story:
Aarav is a 5-year-old bright and cheerful boy who loves playing with his toy cars and dreams of becoming a pilot one day. However, his dreams and life have come to a sudden halt. Recently, he was diagnosed with a severe congenital heart defect that requires urgent open-heart surgery.

His condition is deteriorating rapidly. He gets breathless even while walking a few steps and his energy levels have dropped significantly. The doctors have advised that the surgery needs to be performed within the next few weeks to save his life.

His parents, Ramesh and Priya, belong to a lower-middle-class family. Ramesh works as a daily wage earner and Priya is a homemaker. They have already exhausted all their meager savings and borrowed from friends and family for Aarav's preliminary tests and medications. 

The estimated cost of the surgery is ₹5,00,000, a sum that is astronomically high for the family. They have nowhere else to turn and are desperately seeking financial help to save their only child. 

Every small contribution will bring Aarav a step closer to a healthy life. Please open your hearts and donate generously to help Aarav get the surgery he urgently needs. Your support can give him a second chance at life.

programs.title: KNT GLOBAL UNIVERSITY
programs.description: A 10,000 acre world-class university offering quality education, research and global opportunities.

detail.introduction: KNT Global University is conceived as a premier global institution designed to nurture future leaders through world-class education, research, and innovation. Set across a massive 10,000-acre campus, it aims to provide an ecosystem where academic excellence meets holistic character development.
detail.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
objectives: To establish a world-class educational hub accessible to all.
To promote advanced research in science, technology, and humanities.
To build a globally recognized faculty and student exchange program.
implementationPlan: Phase 1: Land acquisition and master planning.
Phase 2: Construction of core academic blocks and hostels.
Phase 3: Faculty recruitment and international partnerships.
Phase 4: Launch of undergraduate and postgraduate programs.
expectedImpact: Empower thousands of students with global standard education.
Create a hub for breakthrough research and innovation.
Generate widespread employment opportunities in the education sector.
detail.futureVision: The future vision for KNT Global University is to rank among the top 100 universities worldwide, producing graduates who are not only academically proficient but also deeply rooted in values and social responsibility.

programs.title: MEGA GAUSHALA & COW RESEARCH UNIVERSITY
programs.description: World's largest Gaushala with research university for cow science, Ayurveda & sustainable farming.

detail.introduction: The Mega Gaushala & Cow Research University project is a pioneering initiative dedicated to the protection, welfare, and scientific study of cows. It integrates traditional wisdom with modern veterinary science to promote Ayurveda, sustainable organic farming, and animal welfare on an unprecedented scale.
detail.quote: Compassion for animals is intimately associated with goodness of character.
objectives: To provide a safe, healthy, and loving environment for thousands of cows.
To conduct scientific research on cow-based agriculture and health products.
To train farmers in sustainable, chemical-free organic farming.
implementationPlan: Design and construct eco-friendly cow shelters with modern amenities.
Establish a dedicated veterinary hospital and research labs.
Set up biogas plants for renewable energy generation.
Launch academic courses on cow science and organic agriculture.
expectedImpact: Rescue and rehabilitate thousands of stray and abandoned cows.
Promote natural farming, leading to healthier crops and soil.
Create a self-sustaining ecosystem powered by biogas and organic manure.
detail.futureVision: To become a global center of excellence for cow science and sustainable living, demonstrating how traditional ecological practices can solve modern agricultural and environmental challenges.

programs.title: ANATHALAYA CITY
programs.description: A model city for orphans providing education, care, values and a bright future.

detail.introduction: This project is a core part of our mission to deliver high-quality, impactful service to vulnerable communities. It is designed with deep empathy and strict operational discipline to ensure long-term, scalable welfare.
detail.quote: Service becomes powerful when vision, planning and action work together.
objectives: To create a scalable and transparent service model.
To serve vulnerable communities with dignity and discipline.
To document progress and improve operational efficiency every year.
implementationPlan: Survey the target area and identify beneficiaries.
Prepare site plan, resources, staff, and partner list.
Execute pilot activities, document photographs and feedback.
Scale the model phase-wise with strict budget discipline.
expectedImpact: Direct, measurable support to vulnerable beneficiaries.
Improved access to essential services and opportunities.
Stronger community trust and documented progress for authorities.
detail.futureVision: The future vision is to develop a disciplined, measurable, and inspirational project that can expand from local service to district, state, national, and global levels. The goal is not only to start an activity, but to create a sustainable model that can serve humanity for generations.
